rules.name: HR:P1_pos
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 正模式初次断裂：C键断裂不加氢（偶电子），P/S通常亦然

rules.name: HR:P2_pos
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 正模式初次断裂：N/O键断裂加两个氢 [M+2H]+

rules.name: HR:P3_pos
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 正模式后续断裂：加一个氢中和碎片 [M'+aH]+（N/O更常见）

rules.name: HR:P4_pos
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 正模式后续断裂：丢一个氢成双键/环 [M'+(a-2)H]+（C/P更常见）

rules.name: HR:N1_neg
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 负模式初次断裂：所有元素不招募氢 [M-0H]-

rules.name: HR:N2_neg
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 负模式初次断裂：C键断裂丢两个氢 [M-2H]-（磷酸亦然）

rules.name: HR:N3_neg
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 负模式初次断裂：S键均裂产生奇电子radical（磺酸盐）

rules.name: HR:N4_neg
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 负模式后续断裂：加一个氢中和碎片（N/O更常见）

rules.name: HR:N5_neg
rules.source: Tsugawa et al., Anal. Chem. 2016 (MS-FINDER, 9 HR rules)
rules.desc: 负模式后续断裂：丢一个氢 [M'-(b+2)H]-（C/P/S更常见）
